row.evidence: Grafana's SCIM docs list the prerequisite as "Grafana Enterprise or a paid Grafana Cloud account with SCIM provisioning enabled", and the pricing page's lowest paid tier is Pro at $19/month + usage.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> free. Grafana Cloud's pricing page now lists only Free, Pro ($19/month platform fee + usage) and Enterprise ($25,000/year minimum spend commit); the June 'Advanced' plan and its ~$25k/yr figure no longer appear, so the June scim_plan is dropped. Grafana's SCIM docs require 'Grafana Enterprise or a paid Grafana Cloud account with SCIM provisioning enabled', and the Feb 2026 GA note says SCIM is available 'for Grafana Cloud', so SCIM sits on the paid Pro tier with no listed upcharge. The pricing page itself does not mention SAML or SCIM (confidence medium); the phrase 'with SCIM provisioning enabled' leaves open whether Pro stacks need Grafana to switch it on. Pricing is usage-based (Grafana visualization from $8 per active user on Pro), so per-user fields stay null. SCIM needs SAML at stack level and supports only Okta and Entra ID; SCIM-provisioned users can only be deactivated, never deleted.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: SAML and SCIM need a paid account; the free tier is limited to 3 active Grafana users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Platform fee plus usage; Grafana visualization starts at $8 per active user beyond 3 included users.

auth.token_source: Administration > Users and access > Service accounts > Add service account (roles: User administration, Teams) > create token

endpoints.notes: Only the /Users path appears literally in the docs; Groups support is inferred from the group provisioning (teams) feature.

deprovision.data_retained: SCIM-provisioned users cannot be deleted from Grafana, only deactivated; the GA note promises automatic seat reclamation and access removal on deactivation.

custom.how: Attributes Grafana does not use are ignored

attributes.notes: Only the Entra ID mapping table documents attributes; externalId is mandatory and must match the SAML userUID / external UID claim.

roles.how: SCIM does not assign roles; basic roles come from Role Sync (SAML role mapping) at login.

limitations.text: Requires SAML authentication from the same IdP; other auth methods are not supported.
Only Entra ID and Okta are supported identity providers.
SCIM-provisioned users cannot be deleted, only deactivated; SCIM-provisioned teams can only be deleted from the IdP.
SCIM Group Sync and Team Sync cannot be enabled together; migration from Team Sync is 'coming soon'.
Only work email addresses are supported.
SCIM is stack-level only; the Cloud Portal (grafana.com) layer cannot be provisioned by SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the current organization
Look up users in the current organization
Add a user to the current organization
Remove a user from the current organization

limitations.text: The global User API (/api/users, /api/admin/users) needs basic auth as a Grafana server admin and cannot use service account tokens; Grafana Cloud customers are pointed to the Organization API instead.

okta.notes: OIN 'Grafana Labs' app has only SAML ticked in its functionality list (SCIM/Create/Deactivate unticked, read from page markup) though its blurb mentions provisioning; Grafana's SCIM guide has you enable SCIM on your own SAML app integration with the generic base URL.

entra.notes: Grafana's guide creates a non-gallery enterprise application; no Entra gallery tutorial for Grafana was found on Microsoft Learn.

google.notes: Not a supported SCIM IdP per Grafana docs.

onelogin.notes: Not a supported SCIM IdP per Grafana docs.

fallbacks.other_sync: Team Sync and Role Sync (SAML group/role mapping at login); LDAP on stacks

conflicts.text: The May 2025 public-preview announcement told users to 'Enable the enableSCIM feature toggle'; the 2026 docs say SCIM is configured in the UI on paid Cloud accounts 'with SCIM provisioning enabled', which leaves open whether Grafana must turn it on per stack.

open_questions: Does SCIM on Grafana Cloud Pro need Grafana support to enable it ('with SCIM provisioning enabled')?
SCIM version, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas endpoints, PUT vs PATCH support and pagination are not documented.
Service account token expiry for the SCIM token is not stated on the SCIM pages.
Whether deactivation revokes active sessions is not documented.
No Grafana Cloud audit-log API or user-event webhooks found in the docs.
